2311.content: Data model Entities + cardinalities candidate, extracted Between requirements and sign-off, and the order is the argument: requirements are statements about things, and the model says what the things ARE. Drafted earlier it is invented from nothing, since the entities come from the phase-2 BPA; drafted later, sign-off approves requirements whose nouns were never pinned — which is how two stakeholders approve one sentence meaning different things. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-requirements.bpmn#Call_DataModel . Decide each adaptation: keep, revise or retire candidate, extracted One recorded decision per affected adaptation, with its reason: keep it as is, revise it to the new version, or retire it because the new version now covers it. A decision to diverge from the new version is recorded as such. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/guideline-updates.bpmn#Task_Decide . Decide what may leave the repository candidate, extracted EDITORIAL, and it is stage 1 rather than a filter bolted to the exporter. kg-export produces the WHOLE graph because inspection wants the whole graph; a portal wants what its readers may see. Running the second as the first is how a QA verdict, a bean's blocking note or an unpublished draft reaches a public cache. Decided once, here, rather than at each consumer. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/kg-to-portal.bpmn#E_Scope . Decide, weighing the recommendations candidate, extracted public-comment decide, or decide: code on GitHub from a login in config.json editors. accepted, accepted-modified, not-accepted, noted, deferred; a reason for all but accepted. Also reopens a decided comment. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/public-comment.bpmn#Task_EditorDecides . Decide: amend, renew or end candidate, extracted The parties decide what happens to the agreement. Deciding to amend or terminate is human; expiry of a computable agreement is already enforced by its ODRL dateTime constraint. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_DecideChange . Declare Distribution Manifest & Named Queries candidate, extracted Write subgraph-manifest.json conforming to folio-nquads-distribution/v1. Declare datasetIri, servedRoute, spine, subgraphs, and audited named SPARQL queries with explicit requiredSubgraphs and typed parameter definitions. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/nquads-distribution.bpmn#A_DeclareManifest . Declare the model where a tool can read it candidate, extracted A model in prose is a proposal; a model in the declaration is a model. Ship a reader in the same change: a model that is only documentation goes inert. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-data-model.bpmn#A_Declare . Declare the mount: harness, repository, pin candidate, extracted An instance { name, source: { remote: { repository, ref } } } in the downstream's root index.config.json, written through writeDeclaredMounts. A folio with no index still reads remoteMounts on its declaration; both at once is refused. ref is a full 40-character commit. Overrides, if any, are keyed by instance name and then by directory id — never by path. The index itself is the index-config skill's. Decide first whether you want a remote mount at all: reading another graph without holding its code is a SUBSCRIPTION, not a mount. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/mount-dependency.bpmn#Task_DeclareMount . Declare the node materialized candidate, extracted The node's state moves from referenced to materialized, carrying purpose, localPath, gates and (archival) fixity. There is NO default state: a node that has not said is invalid, because 'the author did not say' and 'the author said they could not tell' are different facts. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/materialize-remote.bpmn#Task_Declare . Declare the purpose: working or archival candidate, extracted working or archival, and it is asked FIRST because three of the five gates mean different things under each. An archival copy keeps the original bytes, never expires, requires fixity, and is the only thing that discharges sourceLoss; a working copy keeps derived content and discharges none of that. A process that gated first and asked afterwards would be judging a copy whose obligations it did not yet know. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/materialize-remote.bpmn#Task_Purpose . Deduplicate, and keep what is actually relevant candidate, extracted The paper's Refiner. Accumulates into the evidence set the report is built from — so what is dropped here is invisible downstream, which is why it is a step somebody performs rather than a filter buried in retrieval. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/deep-document-research.bpmn#A_Refine . Deploy the MVP to staging candidate, extracted An MVP is shared AS A branches/ DEPLOY, not as a description of one. feature-staging.yml publishes the branch under branches/<branch-slug>/ on gh-pages and comments the URL on the PR, so the stakeholder who tests it is looking at the built artefact rather than at a screenshot — the same argument the merge discipline makes about rendered work: holding a rendered change back for assessment makes assessment harder, not safer. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-deliver.bpmn#A_DeployStaging . Deploy the rendering candidate, extracted publish-site.ts commits the staged tree onto gh-pages as a full replace (run by the instance's Pages workflow on a push to main, or by an agent with its own git credentials); GitHub Pages then builds it from the branch. Rebuild and retry on a rejected push; never rebase the branch. The report names the gh-pages commit SHA. BPMN activities of bootstrap-tools · source bootstrap-tools/processes/render-kg-to-github-pages.bpmn#A_Deploy . Deploy to branches/<slug>/ candidate, extracted The stage job copies the built site into gh-pages under branches/<branch-slug>/, then staging-share.ts apply keeps only the files that differ from the live site. The preview's staging-sw.js serves every other file from the live site and puts the staging banner back on it. Other previews and the main site are left as they are. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review-stage.bpmn#Task_DeployStaging . Derive content from the assets candidate, extracted See ingest-derive-content.bpmn. Most of this subprocess is not implemented yet. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/l1-document-ingestion.bpmn#CallActivity_Derive . Derive the metamodel in use candidate, extracted Tool archimate-metamodel (archimate:metamodel --check, on the instance root): the element types the model uses and every (source type, relationship, target type) pattern, each checked against ArchiMate's relationship table. Placeholder elements named after their own type are reported, never fatal: removing them is the author's call. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/archimate-publish.bpmn#A_Metamodel . Describe the desired change candidate, extracted Author describes the content change in natural language. Example: "Update the immunization schedule to add a booster at 18 months." . BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review.bpmn#Task_DescribeChange . Describe the intended change candidate, extracted The editor states the change in natural language; no content has moved yet. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/editing-hci-validation.bpmn#Task_DescribeChange . Describe the need (chat, issue, discussion) candidate, extracted The BA describes the capability gap in their own words. They do not need to know it is called CRDM. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-requirements.bpmn#BA_Submit . Detect change scope & impact candidate, extracted Agent analyses the requested change: - Which content blocks are affected? - Are there downstream implications (indicators, referral logic, visit schedules)? - Will deterministic logic (CQL/DMN) need updating? skill: content-graph, integration-watcher . BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review-make.bpmn#Task_DetectScope . Detect feature request (crdm-detect skill) candidate, extracted Recognise the request as a platform capability change rather than content work, from crdm-detect's signals. Never call it "CRDM" to the person. Mid-content-work, ask whether to pause for requirements now or record a work item for later — do not switch on your own. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-requirements.bpmn#A_Detect . Detect media type, mint a doc id candidate, extracted Sniff the media type rather than trusting the extension, and mint the doc id from the page-1 arXiv stamp where there is one, else from the filename. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/l1-document-ingestion.bpmn#Task_Detect . Detect the interaction modality candidate, extracted Before the first question is asked, establish HOW to ask it: audio, ordinary chat, selectable options for a user with limited hand function, large-type for low vision. A user who finds the questions unusable never reaches the rest of this diagram. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/conduct/getting-started.bpmn#Task_DetectModality . Detect what moved candidate, extracted translation:status --instance <root> for new, obsolete and fuzzy strings, and the instance's template check. Either failing, or showing anything but zero, is a change. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/translation-refresh.bpmn#Task_TR_Detect . Determine the context: what is known, and already decided candidate, extracted Before composing anything: what is already known, each fact with where it came from; which declaration governs the matter (the instance's <name>.json, the diagram the caller is in, the Skill its task names); what state is recorded; and whether the question has ALREADY been decided — by the person earlier in the conversation, or in a declaration that quotes their ruling. A settled question is not asked again: asking it reopens a decision and spends the person's attention twice. Read it, do not remember it: cite what you read. What the caller handed in is checked here, not re-derived. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/human-agent-discussion.bpmn#A_DetermineContext . Determine the process and task, or that you are idle candidate, extracted Name the Process, the lane and the task the question belongs to, and say so in the message: "Process: Initialize a harness, at Determine the harness and repositories, as the Bootstrapping Agent". A reader who does not know which process you are in will assume the last one's rules still hold. If you are in no Process, that is an answer too: you are IDLE, and what you are doing is classifying a request to find the Process it belongs to — say that, rather than presenting a question as though a step had asked for it. You are OUT of process, and it is undetermined, when you cannot name the Process, when two candidates fit, when the step you believed was next is not the one the diagram enables, or when the work in hand was not what you said you would do. Do not infer your way back in. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/human-agent-discussion.bpmn#A_DetermineProcess . Determine the roles: which you act as, and the person's candidate, extracted An Actor performs a task in a Process AS a Role. Nothing is a Role by nature: the same agent is the Bootstrapping Agent in one diagram and another Role in the next, and which one it is depends on the lane of the task it is performing now. So say which Role you are acting as — the lane of the CALLING task, since this lane is variable — and which Role the person you ask holds (the Requestor, or whoever the calling lane names). It decides what you may ask them for: only the Requestor chooses a harness, and a question put to somebody who does not hold the decision gets an answer that settles nothing. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/human-agent-discussion.bpmn#A_DetermineRoles . Determine where you are: process, roles, context candidate, extracted Before narrowing, say where this is happening, in the words you will use in the question. PROCESS: Initialize a harness, at its first step, inside Determine the harness and repositories — the only place a Bootstrapping Agent can be (FR-2). If you cannot say that (you were started some other way, or a step you believed done is not), you are out of process: do not infer your way back in. ROLES: you act as the Bootstrapping Agent because you were told so; the person you will ask is the Requestor — the one who asked for the harness, and the only one who may choose it. A request relayed by somebody else leaves the Requestor undetermined. CONTEXT: what the request said, and what the checkout holds — a declaration at its root, a harness named in the request. Whatever cannot be determined is handed to the called discussion as undetermined, and asked about first; it is never filled with a default. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/discussion.bpmn#A_DetermineWhere . Determine which CDN, the root URL and the Subgraphs candidate, extracted Every Subgraph id asked for must be one the declaration lists; none means the whole graph. The root URL is the one given. The target's Tool is the one that satisfies: ["render-kg-to-cdn"] for that CDN — gh-pages for GitHub Pages. A caller that already rendered and verified its tree hands the tree over instead of the graph, and the Tool pushes it without rendering again. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/render-kg-to-cdn.bpmn#Task_Resolve . Determine which harness, and where candidate, extracted The candidates are listed and the Requestor is asked, in discussion, which asks through human-agent-discussion. IN: nothing but the context this agent was handed. OUT: zero or ONE harness, and the locations — a document conforming to discussion.output.schema.json. One at most: a list of two is not an answer, and the Bootstrapping Agent may not break the tie itself. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/initialize-harness.bpmn#A_DetermineHarness . Discuss it with the person candidate, extracted Bootstrap's human-agent discussion, given the composed question. Its Ask ONE question step is where this harness's delivery rule applies: Post the whole composed question as ordinary chat text BEFORE any card. This is the copy that survives: a card, once answered, shows only the chosen option, and a dismissed card shows nothing. Never "see the card", never a request for a typed reply such as "1y 2n". Then the card: Whatever the host calls its selection tool (AskUserQuestion, request_decision, a button card): the same letters and labels as the chat text, the recommended option marked. No host card tool: say so in the chat and keep each answer to one short choice. Its answer step: One tap on the card, or any answer the person prefers to give. Free text is always available and never required. A dismissal is NOT an answer and never selects the default as a choice; the question stays open in the chat. On an answer: Hand the answer back to the calling step, quoted. If it settles how a kind of thing is decided, it is a rule: write it into the governing skill in the same turn. On no answer: Do what the question said would happen with no answer, and say so. Nothing irreversible proceeds on a default: such a step waits for the person. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/ask-the-person.bpmn#Call_Discuss . Distribute to the public candidate, extracted The committee and the editor send the announcement through their channels. Comment is open from here until the agreed close. Skill: public-comment. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/public-comment-release.bpmn#Task_Distribute . Do it, then check again candidate, extracted Only what the agent, or a tool it has, can do without replacing anything somebody wrote: regenerate a README section, add a missing Pages workflow, switch Pages on with an authenticated gh. Performing is not the same as done: the flow goes back to the check, and only the check says done. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/complete-initialization.bpmn#A_PerformStep . Draft the block edit candidate, extracted The authoring agent produces a PROPOSED change. Nothing is written to the corpus yet. For a rendered change it also produces the before/after preview (skill before-after-preview) here, before Gateway_ValidationFork, so the preview exists when the parallel review starts. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/editing-hci-validation.bpmn#Task_DraftEdit . Draft, review and publish candidate, extracted See draft-to-publication.bpmn. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-lifecycle.bpmn#CallActivity_Publication . Drain: land, close or re-target the open PRs candidate, extracted Work the PRs seed:ready named until the source settles: land or close the heavy movers and the next layer's PRs, bring the layer's open PRs to five or fewer, and finish any move in flight. Fix a red rehearsal or a discovery miss where it is. Nothing is seeded from here; it goes back to the gateway, which re-asks. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/global-tasks.bpmn#GT_Drain . Drain: land, close or re-target the open PRs candidate, extracted Work the PRs seed:ready named until the source settles: land or close the heavy movers and the next layer's PRs, bring the layer's open PRs to five or fewer, and finish any move in flight. Fix a red rehearsal or a discovery miss where it is. Nothing is seeded from here; it goes back to the gateway, which re-asks. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/kg-separation.bpmn#Task_Drain . Drain: land, close or re-target the open PRs candidate, extracted Work the PRs seed:ready named until the source settles: land or close the heavy movers and the next layer's PRs, bring the layer's open PRs to five or fewer, and finish any move in flight. Fix a red rehearsal or a discovery miss where it is. Nothing is seeded from here; it goes back to the gateway, which re-asks. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/sub-kg-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_Drain . Draw the board of todos and beans candidate, extracted The todo board mounts inside the landing board, so harness cards and todo stickies share one surface. Each card carries an edit link only when the build composed one. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/harness-default-rendering.bpmn#A_Board . Draw the sample candidate, extracted On a first translation: every diagram label, every persona and scenario string, and a seeded random fraction of the rest, with the seed written down so the sample can be drawn again. On a refresh: only the strings that were new or fuzzy. Hand the back-translator the msgstr values alone, keyed by an opaque id. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/translation-round-trip.bpmn#Task_RT_Sample . Drop its positions and sweep orphans candidate, extracted Only after the content has moved: drop its positions from the layout layer and sweep any position whose note is now gone. Sweeping first would make the board authoritative over the folio for one step. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/ui/board-relocate.bpmn#A_UpdateLayer . Drop the file in the queue candidate, extracted Through the forge's upload form, a commit, or any other route that lands the file in the declared queue. The agent watches rather than chases: an arrival may be minutes or days away. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/content-acquisition.bpmn#P_Upload .

2313.title: Glossary: BPMN activities, E–Q
2313.content: Candidate terms extracted from every BPMN task and call activity: name as the label, its own <documentation> as the definition, the element id as the code. Each is the asset’s own text, verbatim and not curated, and carries the badge “candidate, extracted”. A person promotes one by authoring it. Authored terms are on their owning instance’s page, and those pages, the counts and the sources are linked from the glossary index. From: bootstrap 38 (SKOS) · bootstrap-tools 7 (SKOS) · cat-harness 365 (SKOS) · folio-assistant-core 244 (SKOS). One of 3 pages of this type, split by the first letter of the label: all parts. Size: this page holds 212 terms and is 180 KB before compression, fetched in one request, within its budget of 1.0 MB. There is no search index: the filter below runs over this page, and the A–Z bar jumps within it. Already somebody else's concept? — check:term-mapping, bean 7wou | target | mapped | unmapped | undetermined | why undetermined | . | fhir | 0 | 902 | 0 | — | . | skos | 0 | 902 | 0 | — | . Undetermined is never “no match”. A vocabulary that could not be reached has said nothing, and the column above keeps that apart from a checked miss. The counts are reported and not graded: an unmapped candidate may be a term this corpus is right to coin. Per term. Every term on this page is unmapped on fhir, and unmapped on skos, unless its entry says otherwise. No entry says otherwise. Filter terms . 212 shown . E F G H I J K L M N O P Q

2314.title: E
2314.content: Edit deterministic logic (if needed) candidate, extracted If the content change affects decision logic, indicators, or workflows: - Update CQL expressions - Update DMN decision tables - Adjust indicator definitions skill: dak-authoring, fhir-pipeline . BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review-make.bpmn#Task_EditLogic . Edit it in place — it is your own content candidate, extracted The ordinary path, drawn so the process does not read as though every edit needs a copy. Content in a writable directory is authored content and is edited where it lives; the copy-out is for somebody else's bytes, not for yours. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/copy-out-materialized.bpmn#Task_EditDirectly . Edit narrative content blocks candidate, extracted Agent modifies the relevant content blocks (.md files, block manifests). Validates each edit against the schema (content_validate). skill: content editing, block builders . BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review-make.bpmn#Task_EditContent . Edit the document as decided, on a feature branch candidate, extracted public-comment edit --branch: the author (human, or an agent in the author role) edits the folio's blocks as the decision says, on a feature branch for one change-set. Its PR says Closes #N for the change-set issue, and opening it moves that issue's accepted comments to editing. Before its preview is staged, the author writes the change set's Disposition (change set) on the Agent tab: one line per comment (No. 136: Accepted...), starting from each comment's Blue Disposition on Review Public Comments, after an optional Overall statement. Quality check: every comment number in the change set has a disposition; the sheet flags gaps and words that differ from the people's. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/public-comment-change.bpmn#Task_AuthorEdits . Edit the document in the row's pull request candidate, extracted One row, one branch, one active pull request: the agent edits on the row's branch and opens its pull request, or updates it when the row comes round again. A closed pull request the committee wants back is reopened, or replaced by a new one on the same branch; earlier ones stay listed in Agentic status. Agentic status (Green) says where it is, and Staging review opens the preview's what-changed page. Before the preview is staged, the agent writes the change set's Disposition (change set) on the Agent tab: one line per feedback item, starting from the people's Blue Disposition, after an optional Overall statement; the sheet shows it in Disposition (agent) and flags any item without a disposition, or one that differs from the people's. It ends with Record agent step (record-agent-step.bpmn): the Agent tab row first, then Feedback (agent) from it, then the sheet read back, never Feedback (agent) alone. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/contributor-feedback.bpmn#Task_EditInPullRequest . Edit the flagged passage and re-inject candidate, extracted The reviewer corrects the passage in the PO rather than sending the whole translation back. Flows to Task_PoInject, so the round-trip QA runs again over the corrected text — "edit the translation and re-run QA", which is what the adjudication step has always offered and what this process could not do. A userTask, not a service task: this is the one step here where a person edits content, and the lane's actor is the reviewer who just adjudicated. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/translation-workflow.bpmn#Task_EditTranslation . Edit, comment or raise todos on the folio's copy candidate, extracted The copied asset is now writable content of the target folio with recorded upstream provenance (KgAsset.source). The folio author may edit it in place, attach review comments, or raise todos (todo-manager) against it. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/copy-into-folio.bpmn#Task_WorkOnCopy . Editing and HCI validation candidate, extracted See editing-hci-validation.bpmn. Runs once per proposed change, not once per cycle. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-lifecycle.bpmn#CallActivity_Editing . Editing and HCI validation candidate, extracted The editing sub-process. Every change to the corpus goes through its HCI validation gate — a red draft is fixed there, never by patching the built artifact. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/draft-to-publication.bpmn#CallActivity_Editing . Ensure the tracking label exists candidate, extracted Create the tracking label (the label input) with --force so it exists before either issue path runs — the close path filters on it too, and on a repository that has never had a finding it would not exist yet. Skipped on an unknown verdict. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/global-tasks.bpmn#GT_EnsureTrackingLabel . Enumerate the source descriptor candidate, extracted Resolve the request against the source's descriptor (one per corpus, in the declared sources/ of the instance that owns it, e.g. who-iris/sources/), read against cat-harness/schemas/library/source-descriptor.ts BEFORE any gate. Three things come from it and none may be guessed. (1) Which subset strategies the source supports — supportsSubset(). (2) Whether a subset stands on its own: when subsetIsSelfContained is false (mathlib), the request is closed over its dependencies here, and every gate after this one is asked about the CLOSURE, because a subset that omits what its members depend on is not a smaller corpus, it is one that does not build. (3) What enumerating the whole costs — enumerationCost(), which is undefined when the descriptor has no measured denominator; SIZE then refuses rather than estimates. A source with no descriptor is not an error here: it is an unknown, and SIZE refuses on it. The descriptor is CALLED here rather than restated. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/materialize-remote.bpmn#Task_Enumerate . Establish origin and licence candidate, extracted Authors, publication, identifier, and the licence the source itself states. No stated licence means reference only: headings, page ranges and a summary in our own words; the file stays in uploads/ (git-ignored) pinned by checksum. A method with no origin is a house process; write a skill instead. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/methodology-from-source.bpmn#A_Origin . Establish the licence from the upload candidate, extracted EARLY: before any derivation, because library/ is holds: content and anything derived first is committed, so refusing it later is a deletion nobody may take unasked. This step sees only the upload itself — the licence recorded in its intake.json (the same stated / unknown record a library manifest carries) and whether a LICENSE file sits beside it. It never infers a licence from extracted text. The verdict is stated, unknown, or UNDETERMINED, and undetermined is never reported as cleared: the pipeline proceeds and says so, because a licence that only extraction can reveal is a later check's to find. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/l1-document-ingestion.bpmn#Task_Licence . Establish who is acting candidate, extracted The first step and not a formality: actor is the one field of the record that nothing else can supply. Every other field is recoverable by reading the repository; who is acting is not. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/session-state-machine.bpmn#A_IdentifyActor . Every identifier dereferences candidate, extracted After the release is live, every published identifier resolves to the file it names. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/kg-separation.bpmn#Task_Verify . Every skill and tool used becomes a Tool candidate, extracted Each script, CLI or checker the process relies on gets a Tool node (tools/<id>/<id>.json) that satisfies a named skill, validated by folio-assistant's ToolDefinitionSchema. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/methodology-from-source.bpmn#A_Tools . Explain each missing permission, with the exact config diff candidate, extracted Per permission: what it allows the agent to do without asking, why a process here needs it, the narrowest form that would do, and the exact change to the Tool's config. Context, options, recommendation, question (interaction-modality §4.1). Least privilege is the recommendation unless there is a measured reason for more. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/secure-agent-permissions.bpmn#Task_Explain . Extract & Skolemize RDF Dataset candidate, extracted Extract the target RDF triples and ensure strict upstream skolemization: transform every blank node into a deterministic IRI under the dataset namespace. Zero blank nodes allowed in serialized N-Quads. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/nquads-distribution.bpmn#A_ExtractSkolemize . Extract claim candidates candidate, extracted candidates.json holds extracted theorems and definitions. Proposals only -- never adjudicated verdicts. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/ingest-extract-structure.bpmn#Task_Candidates . Extract every template once candidate, extracted Scan the source content and write the translatable strings to .pot files at the configured granularity: segment prose by paragraph, shield what must not be translated (math, code, labels, Lean companions) as placeholders, normalise whitespace, and extract metadata such as titles, alt text and captions. Tool: the translation_extract MCP tool. Once, for every locale: the .pot templates for the pages, the diagrams (translate-bpmn --extract) and the glossary schemes, each by the instance's own extractor. A locale that would need a different template is a defect in the extraction, not a reason to extract again. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/multi-locale-translation.bpmn#Task_ML_Extract . Extract its metadata into the KG candidate, extracted THE METADATA STEP. What enters the knowledge graph is the asset's INDEX — what it is, how big, what type, when it says it was written — and, for a container, what is in it; its contents do not go in unless somebody asks, with a reason. The tool is cat-harness-tools/scripts/extract-assets.ts, writing a folio-extraction/v1 record (schemas/content/extraction.ts). The media type is sniffed from the leading bytes, never taken from the extension. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/document-ingestion.bpmn#Task_ExtractMetadata . Extract structure candidate, extracted See ingest-extract-structure.bpmn. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/l1-document-ingestion.bpmn#CallActivity_Extract . Extract the POT candidate, extracted Scan the source content and write the translatable strings to .pot files at the configured granularity: segment prose by paragraph, shield what must not be translated (math, code, labels, Lean companions) as placeholders, normalise whitespace, and extract metadata such as titles, alt text and captions. Tool: the translation_extract MCP tool. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/human-translation-workflow.bpmn#Task_ExtractPOT . Extract the text layer candidate, extracted The document has a text layer: extract it with pdf-extract (pdfminer.six, then a zero-dependency content-stream reader). Exit 2 means no text layer — a scan — and routes to OCR; it is not an empty document. Extract translatable strings (POT) candidate, extracted Scan the source content and write the translatable strings to .pot files at the configured granularity: segment prose by paragraph, shield what must not be translated (math, code, labels, Lean companions) as placeholders, normalise whitespace, and extract metadata such as titles, alt text and captions. Extract translatable strings (POT) candidate, extracted Scan the source content and write the translatable strings to .pot files at the configured granularity: segment prose by paragraph, shield what must not be translated (math, code, labels, Lean companions) as placeholders, normalise whitespace, and extract metadata such as titles, alt text and captions. 2315.title: F
2315.content: Feature sign-off on issue candidate, extracted Stakeholders sign off on the delivered feature on the issue, having tested the built artefact rather than a description of it. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-close.bpmn#S_FeatureSignoff . Fetch & Ingest Missing Subgraphs (.nq.gz) candidate, extracted Fetch missing partition payloads over HTTP (servedRoute) or local files, decompress gzip streams, and ingest quads directly into store. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/named-query-execution.bpmn#A_FetchPartitions . Fetch and validate the pinned declaration candidate, extracted A sparse, shallow fetch of the substrate's root declaration only. Two questions: does it parse as bootstrap's KnowledgeGraphDeclarationSchema, and does it declare at least one harness? could not fetch is a third answer and is never read as conforms. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/subscribe-kg.bpmn#Task_Validate . Fetch, and record fixity candidate, extracted Fetch, then record sha256 and byte count. Fixity is REQUIRED for an archival copy: an archive that cannot demonstrate it is unchanged is a copy, and it cannot be re-fetched to check, because the thing it would be re-fetched from is what it exists to survive. The data already exists — every structure.json carries sha256 and bytes, and nothing reads them as fixity. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/materialize-remote.bpmn#Task_Fetch . File feedback as beans candidate, extracted Triaged feedback re-enters the work plan as beans, which is how the next cycle knows what it is for. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_FeedbackBeans . File info, sizes, hashes, timestamps, mimetype candidate, extracted NOT IMPLEMENTED; see docs/document-ingestion.md. Mechanical and cheap; the checksum is what makes a remote asset verifiable. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/ingest-derive-content.bpmn#Task_TechMeta . File the source errors as one issue candidate, extracted One issue for every source-text error the translators found, each with its location and the reading the translator took. Never fixed in a translation: a fix to the source is a source PR, and the next refresh carries it to every locale. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/multi-locale-translation.bpmn#Task_ML_SourceIssue . Filter the corpus, choose the granularity, decompose the question candidate, extracted The paper's Planner. Three outputs, and the middle one is the method's substance: a filtered document subset, the granularity to search at, and the sub-questions. CHOOSING THE GRANULARITY PER QUESTION is the whole point of parsing at several. A broad question is answered from summaries and a specific one from chunks; a pipeline that picks once has answered every future question the same way. This checkout cannot yet offer the choice — l1-blocks.ts produces blocks, there is no summary level — so this step SAYS which granularity it searched rather than implying the corpus offered alternatives. Re-entered on every iteration, not only the first: the sub-questions are re-derived from what has been found so far, which is what makes the loop a search rather than a retry. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/deep-document-research.bpmn#A_Plan . Fix each drift on the PR candidate, extracted Correct each string the adjudicator ruled drift, on the locale PR, and note the fix beside the ruling in the QA report. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/multi-locale-translation.bpmn#Task_ML_FixDrift . Fix the relationship in Archi candidate, extracted The author changes the relationship's type or ends in Archi and commits the model again. The pipeline never rewrites a model. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/archimate-publish.bpmn#A_FixModel . Follow it, and say that you did candidate, extracted A stated step — a harness's own docs/bootstrap/initialization.md. Read it and do what it says. It stays stated in the record: nothing can observe that it was followed, and the record does not pretend otherwise. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/complete-initialization.bpmn#A_FollowStated . Follow them, at each location candidate, extracted The instructions belong to the harness being installed, not to bootstrap — bootstrap does not know what any Harness above it requires, and does not need to. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/initialize-harness.bpmn#A_Install . Follow up, narrower candidate, extracted The answer did not settle it: it named a kind rather than an option, or chose two. Ask once more, narrower, naming what the first answer left open. Once: an agent that keeps asking has stopped narrowing. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/human-agent-discussion.bpmn#A_FollowUp . Format Universal Result Response Envelope candidate, extracted Serialize query results into NamedQueryResponseSchema envelope: queryId, executionTimeMs, rowCount, bindings (for SELECT), boolean (for ASK), or quads (for CONSTRUCT). BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/named-query-execution.bpmn#A_FormatResponse . Frame the question as PICO candidate, extracted Population, Intervention, Comparator, Outcome. The PICO is what makes the search reproducible and the evidence auditable: without it, 'we looked for evidence' is not a claim anyone can check. WHO guideline development states the question this way before any retrieval. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/evidence-retrieval.bpmn#Task_FramePico .

2316.title: G
2316.content: Gate every slice: slice:sqlite:check candidate, extracted For every slice: build twice and require one sha256; read the row digest back from the file and require it to equal the digest computed from the source without SQLite; run an FTS5 phrase query for a known row; and audit the payloads with auditPayloadTree (deploy payloads as written, the kg slice's pointers against the committed payload tree). A slice whose rows do not match its source fails; it never passes as whole. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/slice-sqlite-publish.bpmn#A_Check . Gather and verify the evidence candidate, extracted Before anything is drafted: the author reads the guidance ALREADY in this content, frames the question as PICO, retrieves candidates across the three evidence classes, and has each candidate's authority resolved against its publisher's own API. A recommendation reaches the drafting step with its evidence attached, or with the gap recorded. This step has nothing to do for content that carries no recommendations -- a mathematics folio has none, and a figure redrawn from its own source adds none -- and the subprocess's first gateway (Gateway_RecommendationInPlay) ends it there at its own event, recording the answer, rather than satisfying the search vacuously. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/editing-hci-validation.bpmn#CallActivity_Evidence . Give a link, a description, or neither candidate, extracted "Or neither" is a real outcome, not a failure. The ask says what happens if nothing comes, and then that happens — the work proceeds without the resource and says so. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/content-acquisition.bpmn#P_Respond . Grant or revoke a permission candidate, extracted A permission travels with the PARTICIPANT and cross-cuts every lane, so unlike a role it cannot be scoped by the diagram it is used in. Granting one is a standing decision, which is why this lane is person-only and why the log capture on this process is on. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/actor-role-administration.bpmn#Task_GrantOrRevoke . Grant, narrow or refuse each candidate, extracted The owner's answer, per permission, in their own words. Quoted verbatim in the record. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/secure-agent-permissions.bpmn#Task_OwnerGrants .

2317.title: H
2317.content: Hand back to the discussion candidate, extracted The composed question goes, unchanged, to the discussion agent, which asks it through this same process on its yes branch and routes the answer back: the sibling's half of Process_HandBackToDiscussion (a task here, not a call, because that process calls this one). The sibling also shows it in its own thread, never only there. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/ask-the-person.bpmn#A_HandBack . Hand it back to the discussion agent candidate, extracted By the host's route: message_coordinator or message_thread in Claude projects; the final report (a json block valid against the input schema) for a subagent; SendMessage for a sibling session. Then keep working on the recommended option where it can be undone, or stop if blocking. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/hand-back-to-discussion.bpmn#S_HandBack . Hand new feedback to the row's agent; take over stalled rows candidate, extracted On every poll, changed or not, new Blue feedback goes verbatim to the agent working the row, and a stalled row is restarted or taken over. For each row: new Blue feedback goes, verbatim and in the same poll, to the thread that owns the row (named in its Agent row or Feedback (agent)), and Feedback (agent) says who has it. A row is stalled when its Blue cells changed, or Ready for agent turned Yes, more than 10 minutes ago and no Agent step was recorded since; or when its agent recorded no step for 2 hours. A stalled row's owning thread is asked once; with no answer within 10 minutes, or a thread that is done or stopped, the watcher takes the row over, or asks the coordinator for a new thread, and writes the new owner, the step and a link into Feedback (agent). BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/review-log-watch.bpmn#Task_StallCheck . Hand over the live link candidate, extracted Confirmed live. The link is given as a link, and the author is told what is on it. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/conduct/getting-started.bpmn#Task_ReportUrl . Hand the candidates to a decision methodology candidate, extracted The candidate strategies go to options-analysis, which selects the decision methodology by context and applies it. SWOT does not make that selection and does not make the decision. What is handed over includes the ambiguities from A_RecordAmbiguous and the fact that the candidates are UNRANKED. A receiving methodology that assumed an ordered list would be reading a priority SWOT never established. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/swot-analysis.bpmn#A_HandOff . Human / SME review candidate, extracted Escalated to a human reviewer or subject-matter expert when the change turns on clinical or scientific judgement. A rendered change reaches the reviewer with its before/after preview (skill before-after-preview). BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/editing-hci-validation.bpmn#Task_SmeReview . Human eyes on the rendered artefact candidate, extracted Easy to drop because merging to main looks like an approval. It is not: merging approves the CHANGE, and this approves what a reader will actually see. A description cannot stand in for it (continual-progress). BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/kg-to-portal.bpmn#E_HumanEyes .

2318.title: I
2318.content: Identify content and target locale candidate, extracted The coordinator selects: - Which content nodes need translation (block, section, chapter, or folio) - The target locale (one of the supportedLocales in <name>.config.json) - The priority and deadline . BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/human-translation-workflow.bpmn#Task_IdentifyContent . Identify entities from the BPA and requirements candidate, extracted Every verb in the BPA whose object is a candidate entity, and every noun in a requirement. An entity with no identifier is an attribute of something else — that test is decisive and belongs to the technique skill. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-data-model.bpmn#A_Entities . Identify the agent Tool(s) acting here candidate, extracted Which coding-agent Tool is running this session, and which others the instance is configured for (each has its own config files: AGENTS.md is read by many; Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot and Codex each add their own). The Tool's adapter says where its permissions live and how a rule is written. A Tool with no adapter is reported, and its permissions are left to the person. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/secure-agent-permissions.bpmn#Task_IdentifyTools . Import into the store, and test the import candidate, extracted The part only this process does. Load the landed sample into the chosen store and check what an import can get wrong: every item arrived (count against the request), identifiers survived (the descriptor's authoritative ones), structure validates against the store's schema, and provenance (source, revision, fixity) is attached to each node. A check that could not run is a failure, not a pass. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/sample-import.bpmn#Task_ImportTest . Import what, where, and who does it candidate, extracted Three questions the scan cannot answer: import these or not; library or content for each group; leave the files where they are or reorganize to declutter. Plus whether to dispatch one ingestion agent or a small swarm. Non-relaxable: nobody's files are moved or imported on inference. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/conduct/getting-started.bpmn#Task_ConfirmImport . Ingest and place each comment candidate, extracted public-comment import / import-narrative: one record per row or cited passage, anchored through review-anchors.json. Status: received. When the review is also kept in a shared Google Sheet, build its Apps Script with Tool review-sheet-sync (from review/public-comment/sheet-sync.json) and have the sheet's owner install it once (Extensions, Apps Script, run installTriggers): the sheet then keeps its page, section, line and comment links and its change-set joins current by itself. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/public-comment.bpmn#Task_Ingest . Ingest into library/ candidate, extracted The harness's basic ingestion flow (document-ingestion.bpmn, Process_Ingestion): the source is accepted, its metadata goes into the KG, and it is catalogued in library/ — held if materialized, recorded as referenced if not. The flow makes no content-type decision: reading a document into sections and blocks — choosing the rung mechanically (embedded outline, pages, OCR), and writing section text only when the licence allows it — is a refinement in the layer above, which calls this same flow first. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/methodology-from-source.bpmn#Call_Ingest . Ingest tagged review comments candidate, extracted Every PR conversation comment that starts with block: <label> becomes a review-comment/1.0.0 todo (open), idempotently, and is published with the preview as review-comments.json. The staging workflow runs this on every push and on every tagged comment; the coordinator owns that it has run before slicing, because the slices are cut around what reviewers have already said. This is the ingest transition of REVIEW_TRANSITIONS. Uses folio-review-comments. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review-committee.bpmn#Task_IngestComments . Ingest the theme candidate, extracted See ingest-theme.bpmn. The subprocess derives one Theme node with kind sticky|webpage|publication, and refuses a source it cannot complete rather than emitting a partial theme. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/l1-document-ingestion.bpmn#CallActivity_IngestTheme . Inject the PO candidate, extracted Read the .po file and the source .md, substitute msgstr for msgid, unshield the placeholders, and write the translated .md to translations/<locale>/. Check structure (paragraph count, heading levels) and completeness (no empty msgstr), and lint (doubled punctuation, orphaned placeholders). Tool: the translation_inject MCP tool. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/human-translation-workflow.bpmn#Task_InjectPO . Inject the PO into translated Markdown candidate, extracted Read the .po file and the source .md, substitute msgstr for msgid, unshield the placeholders, and write the translated .md to translations/<locale>/. Check structure (paragraph count, heading levels) and completeness (no empty msgstr), and lint (doubled punctuation, orphaned placeholders). Tool: the translation_inject MCP tool. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/global-tasks.bpmn#GT_InjectPo . Inject translations (PO → Markdown) candidate, extracted Read the .po file and the source .md, substitute msgstr for msgid, unshield the placeholders, and write the translated .md to translations/<locale>/. Check structure (paragraph count, heading levels) and completeness (no empty msgstr), and lint (doubled punctuation, orphaned placeholders). Tool: the translation_inject MCP tool. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/translation-workflow.bpmn#Task_PoInject . Instantiate the harness: write its config candidate, extracted Write <harness>.config.json at the repository root, plus the state directories the harness declares, and — where the checkout has a root index.config.json — add the harness to its instances[] (kg:instantiate does both), because the index, not the file, is then what reads as INSTANTIATED (index-config skill); a root config the index does not list fails check:landing-instance. That instantiation is what puts the harness in the navbar's bottom region. check:instance-render must be green on the result; a config that renders nothing is an entry pointing nowhere. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/subscribe-kg.bpmn#Task_Instantiate . Integrate: call existing processes candidate, extracted The method's steps become a process whose judgement points call the processes that already exist (adjudication, options analysis, review) by calledElement. Nothing is re-implemented. A needed change to an existing process becomes a bean against its owner. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/methodology-from-source.bpmn#A_Integrate . Integration test and QA sweep candidate, extracted Corpus-wide checks that a single-block gate cannot make: cross-references, build green, proof status, QA axes across the whole folio. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_Test . Inventory the ingested assets candidate, extracted Which graphical assets arrived, for which surfaces of the website or app design, in which locales, and at which VIEWPORTS: every surface at a web width and at a mobile width. Read off the ingested artefacts rather than off the intent — a layout the source declares but does not supply is not in the inventory, and a surface the design needs but no asset covers is the one that would ship wrong. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/theme-ui-review.bpmn#A_Inventory . Is every derived artefact present? candidate, extracted L1 source to L1 KG is NOT complete while a required derived artefact is missing. This is the gate that makes the derivation steps obligatory rather than aspirational. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/ingest-l1-completeness-gate.bpmn#Task_CheckDerived . Iterate on author feedback candidate, extracted Agent receives revision requests from the author and applies changes. Each push triggers a new staging deployment with updated SHA stamp. A revision push does not pass through Task_CommitPush, so for a rendered change the agent refreshes the before/after preview here (skill before-after-preview), and the next review round never reads a stale one. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review.bpmn#Task_Iterate .

2319.title: J
2319.content: Judge the assets in their design candidate, extracted A person looks at the ingested assets laid out in the design they are for, at BOTH a web and a mobile width. THIS IS A HUMAN STEP INSIDE INGESTION, stated rather than hidden: ingestion of a THEME SOURCE is attended at this step, while ingestion of everything else never reaches it. A judgement made at one viewport is incomplete, not passed, and the wireframe of the surface (wireframe-design-review) says what each layout was meant to be. A clean build, a passing suite and every gate can all miss what only rendering the page and looking finds. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/theme-ui-review.bpmn#R_Judge .

2320.title: K
2320.content: Keep it as a trial: the unpublished trashcan candidate, extracted A trial goes to the kept trashcan: addressable, exported, never published. Its node declares $schema: folio-fsh-guts/v1 and carries the bean or issue it was written under, since it was never moved from anywhere and a movedFrom would be invented provenance. It is NOT refreshed: a trial records what the source looked like when it was tried. Promoting a trial means running this process again with permanent = yes, so the gates are asked afresh. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/sample-import.bpmn#Task_Trial . Keep the edit, re-pin candidate, extracted The local edit wins, so nothing is re-materialized — and the pin moves to the upstream revision that was compared against. Re-pinning is the half that is easy to forget and is the reason this is a step rather than an absence: without it the same upstream change is detected as new on every cycle, and a contributor is asked the same settled question for ever. The record says the copy is deliberately divergent FROM a named revision, which is a different claim from being stale against an unknown one. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/refresh-materialized.bpmn#Task_KeepLocal .

2321.title: L
2321.content: L1 completeness gate candidate, extracted See ingest-l1-completeness-gate.bpmn. Skill-backed by l1-document-ingestion: its section "What a complete L1 entry holds" names check:l1-complete as the gate and states its three results. The gate contains one adjudication (Task_FlagDrift: real, spurious or source-wrong), and its own Task_Verdict records the answer as a reason against the verdict before returning. So both answers reach this step, and nothing here branches on them; Gateway_Complete branches on the gate's completeness verdict instead. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/l1-document-ingestion.bpmn#CallActivity_Gate . Land it in library/ candidate, extracted A permanent sample joins the library as an L1 source, with the materialization record (purpose, gates, fixity) beside it. From here refresh-materialized governs it. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/sample-import.bpmn#Task_Library . Land the bytes in the copier's own folio/ candidate, extracted Into the copier's own declared folio/, never a scratch area — a directory nobody declared is a directory nobody gates, and the copy would be publishable by accident. The copy is NOT read-only: it is the copier's own content, makes no claim about anybody else's bytes, and freezing it too would mean the next person needs a copy of the copy. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/copy-out-materialized.bpmn#Task_Land . Land the feature's PRs candidate, extracted Phase 6's "explicit confirmation before merging to main", made a step that can refuse. Once per pull request the feature still has open, after the sign-off is recorded and before the issue is closed: an issue is not closed on a feature that is not on main. merge-to-main.bpmn reads each head's evidence live, establishes that the owner authorised THAT merge (a stakeholder sign-off or the BA's confirmation is acceptance of the feature, not authorisation to merge it, unless the owner's own words say so), records the authorisation, merges, and confirms the base. A PR the owner holds or refuses stays open, and A_Close then waits: the BA's authorisation to close does not cover a feature that did not land. An increment the owner asked to land earlier in Phase 6 went through the same sub-process at that time. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-close.bpmn#Call_MergeToMain . Languages: extracted, rendered, and RTL candidate, extracted Every user-facing string reaches the .pot; every declared locale renders without clipping or overflow; right-to-left is laid out rather than mirrored by accident. New UI is where untranslated strings enter, because nothing was stale — there was nothing there before. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/theme-ui-review.bpmn#A_Locales . Lay out the options, with what each costs candidate, extracted Every option the agent could narrow the question to, each with what it costs and what it makes hard to undo. Narrow from context first: an option the agent could have ruled out itself wastes the reader's attention. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/human-agent-discussion.bpmn#A_LayOutOptions . Leave a reachable way back candidate, extracted Leave the way back reachable: the collapsed window becomes a control in its own position and focus moves to it — left alone, focus lands on <body> and the keyboard position is lost. An action whose inverse is not reachable is not a toggle. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/ui/board-open-close.bpmn#A_OfferWayBack . Leave it as feedback candidate, extracted With no write tool the reader's point is not lost: it is recorded as feedback for someone who can write. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/harness-default-rendering.bpmn#A_Todo . Leave it referenced, record why candidate, extracted A refusal is not a failure of the process — it is the process working. The node stays referenced, which means the graph still knows it exists and where, and the refusing gate's basis is recorded so the next caller does not re-litigate it. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/materialize-remote.bpmn#Task_StayRef . Leave the content exactly where it is candidate, extracted The reader said no: nothing moves, no position is dropped, and the board is left exactly as it was. Drawn as its own end state because a destructive action whose refusal is not drawn gets performed by accident. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/ui/board-relocate.bpmn#A_Cancel . Link L1 nodes into the corpus graph candidate, extracted Anything in library/ is L1 source content. A knowledge-graph reference from any artefact -- paper, L2, L3 -- resolves to it through library/. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/ingest-build-l1-kg.bpmn#Task_Link . Link the work to an issue candidate, extracted Feature work must be linked to a GitHub issue. Scan before creating, and never create one without the BA's permission — an issue is the stakeholder's record, not the agent's scratchpad. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-requirements.bpmn#Call_Issue . Link to existing issue candidate, extracted A match was found: ask the person whether the requirements go on #NNN, then link the work there. The issue is where stakeholders sign off, so no phase proceeds without one. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-issue-linking.bpmn#A_LinkIssue . List the harnesses this could be candidate, extracted Zero or more. The candidate everybody has is bootstrap itself. Context may name others: "please set up <owner>/<repo> here" names one, and so does any Harness built on bootstrap that the Requestor mentions. This step narrows; it does not decide. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/discussion.bpmn#A_ListHarnesses . List the locations this could install to candidate, extracted Zero or more. Is this a git repository already, or were one or more URLs to repositories supplied? Both are Knowledge Graph Data Stores; the difference is only how they are reached. A location whose root already holds a declaration, <name>.json, is not a blank slate, and says so in the question. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/discussion.bpmn#A_ListLocations . List the steps the declarations name candidate, extracted In the order of the table in initialization-steps: declaration, needs, each dependency's instructions, the documents at their IRIs (checked above; the report leads with them), directories, assets, README, README sections, site. Each step names the declaration that names it, so a reader can see why it is there. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/complete-initialization.bpmn#A_ListSteps . Load the active voices candidate, extracted The activated set only, never everything shipped. An id naming no shipped voice is an error rather than a skip — a folio that believes it is applying a voice and is applying nothing has the cleanest-looking output of the three. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/content/voice-review.bpmn#Task_LoadActive . Log findings on the bean candidate, extracted Findings are appended to the bean, so the next agent or human sees what is outstanding. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/editing-hci-validation.bpmn#Task_LogFindings . Log the failure candidate, extracted Every failure path passes through here, so "logged as failed" is a step somebody performs rather than an adjective on an end event. What differs between the ways in is the message, which is an input, not the mechanism. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/initialize-harness.bpmn#A_LogFailure . Log the start of the install candidate, extracted REQUIRED logging, which is what drawing the call says. Logged before anything is written, so an install interrupted halfway is distinguishable from one never begun. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/initialize-harness.bpmn#A_LogInstallStart .

2322.title: M
2322.content: Make sure every step is done candidate, extracted Following a harness's instructions once is not the same as every step being done. complete-initialization walks the steps the declarations name — FIRST the harness's JSON Schemas and JSON-LD at the IRIs they name, the primary step of initializing a Knowledge Graph harness; then declared directories, assets, the README and its sections, and the site that carries the documents — checks each, does what can be done, asks the person for what only they can do, and reports every step in its state. An agent may be dispatched to run it on its own: it needs nothing but that diagram and the declarations. BPMN activities of bootstrap · source bootstrap/processes/initialize-harness.bpmn#A_CompleteInitialization . Make sure gh-pages exists and Pages serves it candidate, extracted Provisioning the target, owned by this process rather than by the publication step that calls it. Pages cannot serve a branch that does not exist, so in order: (1) an orphan gh-pages branch exists — git ls-remote --heads origin gh-pages; if absent, push a placeholder (index.html + .nojekyll); (2) Pages is on, Source = the gh-pages branch at / — gh api -X POST repos/<o>/<r>/pages -f source[branch]=gh-pages -f source[path]=/ when gh is signed in, otherwise the exact manual step (Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → gh-pages, / (root)). Each half is done, not done, or could not be determined; never assumed. BPMN activities of bootstrap-tools · source bootstrap-tools/processes/render-kg-to-github-pages.bpmn#A_Provision . Make the change candidate, extracted content-change-review-make.bpmn: scope the change, branch, edit content and logic, assess and absorb the downstream impact, and push. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review.bpmn#Call_MakeChange . Make the change, check it and merge it candidate, extracted The second phase, drawn on its own page (public-comment-change.bpmn): an author edits the document as decided on a feature branch, the change set is reviewed on its staging preview, an independent QA gate checks the dispositions against the pull request, and each comment it answers is marked incorporated when it merges. A withdrawal still interrupts the comment while this runs. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/public-comment.bpmn#CallActivity_MakeChange . Map the affected layers in order candidate, extracted Run the re-pin planner (mount:repin:cone) with the fleet and the changed repository. It lists every site downstream in waves, so a site moves only after the layers it takes from have moved, and marks which sites are ready now. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/guideline-updates.bpmn#Task_MapCone . Map values onto palette roles candidate, extracted surface / ink / edge / accent, shared across every kind. A palette per kind would be three spellings of "accent colour", free to disagree about what an accent IS. Where the source is SILENT on a role, say so and mark the value a choice rather than dressing an invention as a measurement. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/ingest-theme.bpmn#Task_MapRoles . Mark every copy answered candidate, extracted Chat copies keep their text: the question struck through and "[Edit: <letter> chosen by <who>, <time>]" added. Cards closed with the chosen option. The sheet's "Decision needed" block replaced by the decision and who made it. Withdrawn or superseded hand-backs marked the same way, with the reason. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/hand-back-to-discussion.bpmn#D_MarkAnswered . Mark incorporated when the change set merges candidate, extracted public-comment incorporate, naming the branch, PR and staging URL; done by the folio's workflow when the PR that closes a change-set issue merges. A PR closed unmerged moves nothing. Ready for merge is set only once the QA gate has passed for the PR's head commit; set earlier, the agent does not merge until it passes. The change set's Dispositions blurb, as it stands when Ready for merge is set to Yes, is the summary that closes its issue. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/public-comment-change.bpmn#Task_Incorporate . Materialise the part candidate, extracted The ONLY way bytes arrive. Purpose first, then the five gates — size, restrictions, copyright, retention, source loss — then fetch with fixity, or stay referenced with the refusing gate's basis recorded. Both ends of that subprocess return here and the walk continues: one part refused is not the subscription refused. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/subscribe-kg.bpmn#Call_Materialize . Materialize remote content (the five gates) candidate, extracted The shared subprocess. It resolves the request against the source descriptor, then asks size, restrictions, copyright, retention and source loss, and either fetches with fixity or leaves the content referenced. This process does not restate any of that; it waits for the outcome. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/sample-import.bpmn#Call_Materialize . Measure the cutover: separation:cutover:check candidate, extracted Run bun run cat separation:cutover:check --site in the SEPARATED repository (Tool separation-cutover-check). Six conditions, each decided by an existing gate and none assumed: every declared layer mounted at its pin; every path a declaration names resolves (check:declaration-resolution — directories, assets, visualisers, needs); no wiring still names the monorepo (livesAt, a submodule, a reusable workflow, a path into the old checkout); no import or reference against the layer order; and the site builds from the mounts alone. A finding inside a mounted layer is upstream's and is listed, not counted. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/kg-separation.bpmn#Task_CutoverCheck . Measure the signals candidate, extracted Files and bytes per instance, clone cost (bun run cat health), gate time, merge contention, the candidate's cohesion and cut (kg:detangle), wrong-direction edges, and the would-be tools package's import cone. Recorded in the work context; none alone is a trigger. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/kg-separation.bpmn#Task_Measure . Mechanical checks, both viewports candidate, extracted Tool wireframe-check renders every candidate at a web and a mobile viewport. It fails on horizontal overflow at mobile width, on placeholder text, and on a missing viewport, and writes screenshots and a script entry per criterion. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/wireframe-design-review.bpmn#D_Check . Merge and publish candidate, extracted content-change-review-publish.bpmn: merge on the owner's explicit confirmation, then remove the staging preview, rebuild main and watch it. An unmerged change keeps its preview. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review.bpmn#Call_Publish . Merge into each locale candidate, extracted Merge each refreshed template into every locale's catalogue: new strings arrive empty, changed ones fuzzy, and obsolete ones are kept as #~ entries, never deleted. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/translation-refresh.bpmn#Task_TR_MergeLocales . Merge the one source PR to main candidate, extracted All the templates in one PR to main, merged before any locale starts, so every translator branches from the same main. Once it has merged, its branch receives nothing more: a later fix to the source is a new PR. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/multi-locale-translation.bpmn#Task_ML_SourcePR . Merge the PR candidate, extracted Merge the instance's PR to main, then confirm the template checks pass on main. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/translation-refresh.bpmn#Task_TR_Merge . Merge the pull request candidate, extracted The agent merges the row's pull request, and Agentic status says merged. The change set's Dispositions blurb, as it stands when Ready for merge is set to Yes, is the summary: it goes into the merge, and closes the change set's issue. It ends with Record agent step (record-agent-step.bpmn): the Agent tab row first, then Feedback (agent) from it, then the sheet read back, never Feedback (agent) alone. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/contributor-feedback.bpmn#Task_Merge . Merge the re-pin with its decided revisions candidate, extracted The re-pin merges when its checks are green and every decision it needs is recorded. Its pull request cites the decisions, which become the release notes for this site's update. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/guideline-updates.bpmn#Task_Merge . Merge, on explicit confirmation candidate, extracted The owner says "merge it", and only then is the branch merged. Merge to main triggers: 1. the main site rebuilds with the changes; 2. the staging preview's cleanup runs; 3. the review comments committed on the feature branch land on main, as the review record. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review-publish.bpmn#Task_Merge . Mirror it to the feedback channel candidate, extracted Review sheet: the "Decision needed" block in the row's agent column, Agentic status Needs you (the document layer's review-sheet-script skill). Issue or PR: a comment. An extra copy, never instead of the discussion. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/hand-back-to-discussion.bpmn#S_Mirror . Mount each instance at its declared path candidate, extracted Sparse checkout of the declaration and the chosen directories, copied to the mount path (by default the instance's home path, so relative imports and sibling discovery hold). Never onto tracked bytes; never onto a directory no lock says this mount made; never over edits to a previous mount — those are left untouched and reported. A replay of the lock tries the index's layers cache ref first (refs/cat/layers/<key>, then refs/cat/layers/main): one shallow fetch, every byte verified against the lock, and any layer that does not verify is fetched from its own repository. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/mount-dependency.bpmn#Task_MountInstances . Mount the branch tip at the declared path candidate, extracted A branch source keyed by tip: branch-store mount --id <dir-id> writes the tip's files at the declared path, so every reader finds the directory where it always was; push splices edits back onto the tip, never forcing, and a same-file race is a conflict. The branch's NAME is the declaring directory's storage (or source) — a branch no declaration names is refused rather than guessed. A commit-keyed branch is read per commit through its own store (qa-store), not mounted. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/mount-subgraph.bpmn#Task_MountBranchTip . Mount the remote tree at its pin candidate, extracted A remote source: another repository's tree at a full 40-character commit. bun run cat mount:remote lays it down at the declared path and locks its tree digest; it is never written back, because the bytes are somebody else's at somebody else's pin. Usually reached through a source.remote instance in the root index.config.json (legacy: remoteMounts), which expands a whole harness and its closure — Process_MountDependency. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/mount-subgraph.bpmn#Task_MountRemotePin . Move into library/<bib-slug>/ candidate, extracted The folder name IS the bibliography citation key, so a citation and a directory are the same string. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/library/l1-document-ingestion.bpmn#Task_Promote . Moving the ref first would make the records of parts not yet refreshed describe a commit the entry no longer names. The cached declaration is replaced so the review that follows shows what the NEW pin offers, including subgraphs that did not exist at the old one.
